profile.name: SMC40步进电机控制器
profile.description: 这是一台用于驱动步进电机的运动控制器，可按设定方向和角度实现精密旋转定位，适合实验室中样品台、光学元件或机械部件的角度调整与重复转动。
profile.description_en: This is a motion controller for driving a stepper motor. It provides precise angular positioning with configurable direction and angle, and is suitable in laboratories for rotating sample mounts, optical components, or other mechanical parts.

registry.name: Anaheim Automation SMC40
